about.title: Moving the Gorge since 1930
paragraphs: Lester Auto Freight / Moving & Storage was first established in 1930 by Dick Lester. Over the years it was an agent for companies like Atlas and Mayflower.
In 1985, Lester Moving & Storage was taken over by our current President, Clinton Adams.
Residential or commercial, across town or across the country, there's no job too big or too small.
